test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 56

questions.question: There are two cones. The radius of the first cone is 12 cm and its height is 15 cm while the radius of the second cone is 16 cm and its height is 18 cm. Determine which of the following statements is correct regarding the volume of the cones.
options: The volume of the first cone is greater than that of the second cone.
The volumes of both the cones are equal.
The ratio between their volumes is 16 : 33.
The volume of the second cone is greater than that of the first cone.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The volume of the second cone is greater than that of the first cone.) है।

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers two successive discounts of 15% and 10% on an article marked at ₹2,000. Find the single equivalent discount percentage.

A boat takes 82 minutes to go 14.9 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 6:2. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 74.6 km upstream and 29.6 km downstream?
A shirt is listed at ₹265 with a discount of 20%. What additional percentage discount must be offered to the customer to bring the net price to ₹106?

A trader offers a discount of 24% on an article if a customer makes the payment in cash. How much percentage above the cost price should he mark the article to make a profit of 24%? (Answer to be rounded off to 2 decimal places.)
A person borrows ₹66,700 at 10% compound interest per year, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays ₹1,100 as part payment. How much does he still owe after two such instalments?
The average of the first 98 whole numbers is:
The average of the first 97 even natural numbers is:
The internal surface area (in m2) of an open cuboidal tank whose internal length, internal breadth and internal height are given as 27 m, 21 m and 48 m, respectively, is:
The base and the corresponding height of a parallelogram are 78 cm and 61 cm, respectively. The area of the parallelogram (in cm2) is:
A cab covers a distance of 666 km in 37 hours. What is its speed in km/hr?
A man deposits ₹7,550 at 13% rate of simple interest per annum. The total amount (in ₹) he will get at the end of 16 years is:

In a river, water is flowing with a speed of 10 km/hr. A motor boat takes equal time in going 84 km downstream and 28 km upstream. How much time will it take to cover 11 km downstream and 63 km upstream?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (6 hours 40 minutes) है।
